contract: Lissen caches JSON reads by validator and sends cover options. A cached JSON 200 carries a weak ETag; a repeat with that If-None-Match answers 304 with no body and the same validator, a stale validator answers the fresh 200, a write changes the validator and the new validator answers 304, and an unauthenticated request with a valid validator still answers 401. The item cover route honours the width, raw and format inputs the mobile apps send: raw returns the original image, width resizes, format/Accept selects jpeg, png or webp, and an unsupported format is 400. The fresh-200-without-ETag case stays a 200. Auth failures are never hidden by a cached 304.

invariants.contract: GET /api/me/progress/:itemId answers 200 with a weak ETag; a repeat with that exact If-None-Match answers 304 with no body and the same ETag; a stale If-None-Match answers 200 with the same progress value; after PATCH /api/me/progress/:itemId changes currentTime the previous ETag answers 200 with the written value and a different ETag, and the new ETag answers 304; an unauthenticated request carrying a valid ETag answers 401 (never 304), with no progress document and no created row.

GET /api/items/:id/cover with width returns a resized image whose decoded width is the requested width: default and format=jpeg are image/jpeg, format=png is a PNG, Accept: image/webp or format=webp is a WEBP image; raw=1 returns the original image/jpeg bytes and ignores width/format; a cached (non-raw) cover carries no ETag, so If-None-Match leaves it a 200 with the same bytes; an unsupported format answers 400 with no image bytes and an unknown item's raw cover answers 404.

exceptions: force is not applicable: no mobile HTTP cache operation has a force/refresh mode; clients send a cache-busting URL or revalidate with a validator instead.
Lissen client evidence: go-backend/testmachine/contracts/clients/lissen.md; these scenarios protect the listed routes/parameters and are not device acceptance.
ETag algorithm, header order and weak-vs-strong formatting are not asserted; only round-trip outcomes are contract.
